headline: IT surged while *banks and staples held back*
subline: Nifty gained 0.25% as 28 of its 50 stocks closed lower.
hero_text: Nifty closed at 25,884.5, up 0.25%. IT jumped 3.66%, while 28 of the 50 Nifty stocks ended lower.

why.title: HCLTech led an IT surge
why.desc: HCLTECH, TCS and INFY pulled the Nifty IT index higher.

why.title: Fear eased through the day
why.desc: India VIX fell to 16.84 from 17.67 as nerves settled.

why.title: Both big pools were buyers
why.desc: FIIs put in Rs 5,843.33 Cr and DIIs added Rs 5,630.72 Cr in cash.

why.title: Europe rose, US was mixed
why.desc: FTSE gained 1.89% and DAX 2.19%, while the Nasdaq slipped 0.62%.

sector_reasons.IT: Led on HCLTECH, TCS and INFY gains
sector_reasons.Realty: Property names ran on a firm bid
sector_reasons.Consumer Durables: Weakest sector as consumer names slid
sector_reasons.Auto: Eased with the rest of consumer demand

bonus_text: 1,497 stocks rose and 1,244 fell, about 1.2 to 1. Only 22 of the 50 Nifty names closed higher.
movers_note_gainers: HCLTECH jumped 6.42%. BSE broke the IT run at 5.70%.
movers_note_losers: Asian Paints fell 2.98%. Bajaj Finance and Shriram Finance trailed close behind.
watch_text: Friday: the Nifty sits between 25,000 put OI and 26,000 call OI. Max pain is 25,800.
lessons: One sector carried the index. IT rose while most Nifty stocks closed lower.
Banks sat out the rally. Bank Nifty slipped while the Nifty gained.
Consumer names moved together. FMCG, durables and auto all closed lower.
Lenders lagged the IT bounce. Bajaj Finance and Shriram Finance sat among the top Nifty losers.
alert_text: Friday brings ex dates for VGL's split and FUSIONCX's dividend. TECHM's 1:1 bonus goes ex on Monday 30 November.
cta_headline: IT did the heavy lifting. *Save this wrap*.
cta_sub: Next bell is Friday 27 November. Full wrap every evening.
next_text: Next bell is Friday. Nifty expiry lands Tuesday.
caption_a:
IT jumped 3.66% but the Nifty gained just 0.25% to 25,884.5.
HCLTECH rose 6.42%, yet 28 of 50 Nifty stocks closed lower.
FIIs bought Rs 5,843.33 Cr and DIIs Rs 5,630.72 Cr in cash.

Watch: 26,000 call OI and 25,000 put OI frame Friday.
